verdict.rationale: Salv documents an in-product AI feature, AI-Powered Insights, that adjudicates sanctions name-match alerts and explains its reasoning (informational only). Since payments are screened in real time, those alerts can arise on transactions, so the product's own AI does give limited alert-investigation support. Case notes exist but are worked manually by analysts. Missing for 10: an agent that investigates transaction-monitoring alerts (not just name matches), AI-drafted review or case notes, multi-step agentic investigation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
